name: 报刊拼贴素材
author: TO DO
description: 复古撕纸报刊拼贴风的单个素材：撕边老照片、报纸标题条、打字机纸条、剪报块、剪贴物件等，一次出一件，可透明底，拿去自己拼版面。

inputs.label: 素材内容
inputs.placeholder: 例如：纽约天际线老照片 / 纸条上写 Dream Plan Do / 一支干枯的花

options.label: 撕边老照片
options.prompt: a black-and-white halftone photograph printed on newsprint, torn out by hand into an irregular rectangle with ragged white fibrous paper edges

options.label: 报纸标题条
options.prompt: a narrow torn strip of newspaper carrying one bold serif headline, with ragged torn edges on all sides

options.label: 打字机纸条
options.prompt: a small torn scrap of off-white paper with a short phrase typed in a typewriter font and a hand-drawn ink underline scribble

options.label: 剪报块
options.prompt: a torn newspaper clipping with a serif headline, a short italic deck and several columns of small body text, rough torn edges

options.label: 剪贴物件
options.prompt: a single object cut out of an old black-and-white magazine photo, with a thin uneven white paper border left around its silhouette, like a scrapbook cutout

options.label: 报头残片
options.prompt: a torn corner of a newspaper front page with a blackletter masthead, a thin rule line, issue number and date line

options.label: 票据 / 邮票
options.prompt: a small piece of vintage paper ephemera such as a ticket stub, postage stamp or tag, slightly worn, printed in black ink

options.label: 英文
options.prompt: Any headline or phrase is short English, spelled exactly as described; small body text is illegible filler

options.label: 中文
options.prompt: Any headline or phrase is short Chinese in bold Song-style serif or typewriter type, written exactly as described; small body text is illegible filler

options.label: 无文字
options.prompt: No readable words anywhere, only illegible tiny print texture if any

options.label: 黑白复古
options.prompt: Strictly monochrome black, white and soft grey, high-contrast halftone print look

options.label: 泛黄旧报
options.prompt: Aged yellowed newsprint and sepia brown-grey tones

options.label: 黑白一抹红
options.prompt: Black and white with one small muted red accent such as an underline or stamp mark

options.label: 干净利落
options.prompt: Clean torn edges and light paper grain

options.label: 适中做旧
options.prompt: Visible fibrous torn edges, fine film grain and halftone dots, faint creases

options.label: 重度做旧
options.prompt: Heavily distressed paper with crumpled creases, frayed edges, dust, ink smudges and photocopy noise

options.label: 纯绿底（抠像用）
options.prompt: The element lies on a perfectly flat, solid pure chroma-key green background (#00FF00), evenly lit, with no shadow, no gradient and no texture; no green anywhere on the element itself

options.label: 深灰纸底
options.prompt: The element lies on a dark charcoal grey textured paper background with a soft contact shadow

options.label: 纯白底
options.prompt: The element lies on a plain pure white background with no shadow

prompt.template: A single isolated collage element in a vintage torn-paper newspaper scrapbook style: {{kind}}, depicting {{subject}}. {{lettering}}. {{tone}}. {{grit}}. Only this one piece of paper, shown flat and straight-on from above, centered with generous empty margin on every side and not touching the image edges, slightly tilted like a real pasted clipping. Realistic paper material and print texture, analog editorial collage aesthetic. {{background}}.
